name: sdcorejs-link-insight
description: Secure BYOK Gemini summaries for Jira and Confluence links in Google Chat.

scripts.build:release: node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs --release-config && wxt build && node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs
scripts.worker:build: cd worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir dist
scripts.worker:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply sdcorejs-link-insight-local --local --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run worker:typecheck && npm run worker:test && npm run worker:build && npm run build
